isrPerLevel.note: Per level of ISR gap. Upper bound from information asymmetry: complete surprise multiplies by up to 2.5 (TNDM, https://dupuyinstitute.org/2019/12/26/how-attrition-is-calculated-in-the-qjm-vs-the-tndm/); spread over ~5 levels, 2.5^(1/5) = 1.20 -> 0.2 per level as high; mid 0.1. Educated guess.

precisionStrikePerLevel.note: Desert Storm: guided munitions were 8% of tonnage but 11 of 55 tons on targets assessed destroyed; per-ton association (11/8)/(44/92) = 2.9. Force-level effect with an 8% guided share: 1 + 0.08 x (2.9 - 1) = 1.15 -> 0.15 per level. High 0.4 for forces whose strike load is mostly guided. GAO cautions the PGM contribution 'is unknowable' from campaign data.

ewPerLevel.note: Per level of communications gap. JTIDS/Link-16 F-15C evaluation (>12,000 sorties): datalink aircraft raised kill ratio by more than 150% over voice-only; 29 Sqn Tornados reached ~4:1. A 2.5x kill ratio ~ sqrt(2.5) = 1.58 power under square-law -> 0.58/level in air combat (high 0.5); ground combat effect smaller, mid 0.15. Educated scaling.

cyberPerLevel.note: Per level of cyber gap. No quantitative battlefield evidence; observed effects in 2022-26 were disruptive but rarely decisive in combat. Educated guess.
